# CRD reference

This page describes every field of the custom resources provided by the Stroom K8s Operator, and every type nested
within them. It is generated from the Go type definitions in
[`api/v1`](https://github.com/gradata-systems/stroom-k8s-operator/tree/master/api/v1), which are also the source of
the CRD schemas installed into your cluster.

!!! info "Generated page"
    Do not edit this page by hand. Change the doc comments in `api/v1`, then run `hack/gen-crd-docs.sh`.
    See [Contributing to the docs](../contributing.md#crd-reference).

You can also query the schema of any field from your cluster, for example:

```shell
kubectl explain stroomcluster.spec.nodeSets.livenessProbeTimings
```

Fields of standard Kubernetes types (such as `PersistentVolumeClaimSpec` or `ResourceRequirements`) link to the
Kubernetes API reference.


## Resource types

All resources belong to the API group and version `stroom.gchq.github.io/v1`.

| Kind | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [DatabaseBackup](#databasebackup) | A scheduled `mysqldump` of a DatabaseServer or external MySQL database, run as a CronJob. |
| [DatabaseServer](#databaseserver) | An operator-managed, single-instance MySQL server for a StroomCluster. |
| [StroomCluster](#stroomcluster) | A Stroom cluster: one StatefulSet of Stroom nodes per NodeSet, plus the Services, Ingresses and configuration they need. |
| [StroomTaskAutoscaler](#stroomtaskautoscaler) | Adjusts the task limit of a Stroom job on each processing node, based on Pod CPU usage. |

### LivenessProbeTimings


LivenessProbeTimings determine the parameters for the Stroom node liveness probe, which queries the Stroom
filtered health check endpoint. Allow and Deny filter which Stroom health checks are run. Each name must be a
health check registered by Stroom, otherwise the probe will fail.


_Appears in:_ [NodeSet](#nodeset)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialDelaySeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `timeoutSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `periodSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `successThreshold` _integer_ |  | `1` |  |
| `failureThreshold` _integer_ |  | `10` |  |
| `allow` _string_ | Allow lists the health checks to run. If empty, all health checks are run, except those listed in Deny.<br />Defaults to the JVM thread deadlock check, so nodes are not restarted when an external dependency is down.<br />Set to an empty list to run all health checks. | `[deadlocks]` | items:Pattern: `^[^,]+$` |
| `deny` _string_ | Deny lists the health checks to exclude. |  | items:Pattern: `^[^,]+$` |

### NodeSet





_Appears in:_ [StroomClusterSpec](#stroomclusterspec)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` _string_ | Name uniquely identifies the NodeSet within a StroomCluster. | `count` _integer_ | Number of replicas (discrete Stroom nodes) to deploy in the NodeSet |  | Minimum: 1 |
| `role` _[NodeRole](#noderole)_ | Role of each node in the NodeSet. `Processing` nodes receive and process data, while `Frontend` nodes serve<br />the Stroom user interface and API.<br />If this property is omitted, nodes in the NodeSet will assume both Processing and Frontend roles. |  | Enum: [Processing Frontend] |
| `managedJobs` _string array_ | Automatically enable the specified job(s) on node startup and disable them prior to node shutdown.<br />If omitted, nodes with the `Processing` role or no role enable and disable all jobs, while `Frontend` nodes<br />only manage the job `Reindex Content`.<br />Jobs that aren't managed may be enabled or disabled via the Stroom Jobs pane. |  |  |

### ReadinessProbeTimings


ReadinessProbeTimings determine the parameters for the Stroom node readiness probe, which queries the Stroom
filtered health check endpoint. Allow and Deny filter which Stroom health checks are run. Each name must be a
health check registered by Stroom, otherwise the probe will fail.


_Appears in:_ [NodeSet](#nodeset)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialDelaySeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `timeoutSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `periodSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `successThreshold` _integer_ |  | `1` |  |
| `failureThreshold` _integer_ |  | `10` |  |
| `allow` _string_ | Allow lists the health checks to run. If empty, all health checks are run, except those listed in Deny. |  | items:Pattern: `^[^,]+$` |
| `deny` _string_ | Deny lists the health checks to exclude. Defaults to the external identity provider check, so nodes keep<br />receiving data while the identity provider is unavailable. Set to an empty list to exclude no health checks. | `[stroom.security.common.impl.ExternalIdpConfigurationProvider]` | items:Pattern: `^[^,]+$` |

### StartupProbeTimings


StartupProbeTimings determine how long a Stroom node is given to start up before it is restarted.


_Appears in:_ [NodeSet](#nodeset)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialDelaySeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `timeoutSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `periodSeconds` _integer_ |  | `5` |  |
| `successThreshold` _integer_ |  | `1` |  |
| `failureThreshold` _integer_ | FailureThreshold multiplied by PeriodSeconds is the base time allowed for a node to start up. | `24` |  |
| `lockWaitAllowanceSeconds` _integer_ | LockWaitAllowanceSeconds is added to the startup time allowed for each additional node in the NodeSet, when<br />the StroomCluster PodManagementPolicy is `Parallel`. This gives nodes time to wait on the Stroom bootstrap lock,<br />which is held while another node upgrades the database. | `30` | Minimum: 0 |

| `adjustmentIntervalMins` _integer_ | How often (in minutes) adjustments are made to the number of Stroom node tasks | `1` | Minimum: 1 |
| `metricsSlidingWindowMins` _integer_ | Sliding window (in minutes) over which to calculate CPU usage vs. the threshold parameters | `1` | Minimum: 1 |
| `minCpuPercent` _integer_ | Minimum CPU usage threshold before the number of tasks is adjusted upwards | `50` |  |
| `maxCpuPercent` _integer_ | Maximum CPU usage threshold before the number of tasks is adjusted downwards | `90` |  |
| `minTaskLimit` _integer_ | Minimum number of tasks auto-scaler may set the node limit to | `1` |  |
| `maxTaskLimit` _integer_ | Maximum number of tasks auto-scaler may set the node limit to | `20` |  |
| `stepAmount` _integer_ | Number of tasks to add/subtract each adjustment interval, based on usage | `1` | Minimum: 1 |

### VolumeClaimDeletePolicy

_Underlying type:_ string

VolumeClaimDeletePolicy determines when Stroom node PersistentVolumeClaims are deleted. If unset, they're never
deleted by the operator.

_Validation:_ Enum: [DeleteOnScaledownAndClusterDeletion DeleteOnScaledownOnly]

_Appears in:_ [StroomClusterSpec](#stroomclusterspec)

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `DeleteOnScaledownAndClusterDeletion` | DeleteOnScaledownAndClusterDeletionPolicy deletes a node's PersistentVolumeClaim when its NodeSet is scaled<br />down, and every node's when the StroomCluster is deleted<br /> |
| `DeleteOnScaledownOnly` | DeleteOnScaledownOnlyPolicy deletes a node's PersistentVolumeClaim when its NodeSet is scaled down<br /> |
